title: The Impact of AI Coding Assistants on Software Engineering: A Longitudinal Study
abstract: arXiv:2605.23135v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: AI coding assistants have become prolific in recent years. Through a longitudinal mixed-methods investigation, we examined how professional software engineers perceive the effects of AI coding assistants in regard to task focus, developer experience, and productivity. Two questionnaires were administered six months apart, yielding 158 eligible participants at the first time point, 101 at the second, and a matched longitudinal cohort of 95. Participants reported spending less time on most development tasks, with 82% reporting less on writing code. We found a broader shift in focus from creation to verification activities. We propose a new category of work we term supervisory engineering work, encompassing the direction, evaluation, and correction of AI output. translated_title: AI编程助手对软件工程的影响：一项纵向研究
translated_abstract: AI编程助手近年来变得非常普及。通过一项纵向混合方法调查，我们研究了专业软件工程师如何看待AI编程助手对任务专注度、开发者体验和生产力的影响。我们分两次（间隔六个月）发放了调查问卷，第一次有158名符合条件的参与者，第二次有101名，并形成了一个95人的匹配纵向队列。参与者报告在大多数开发任务上花费的时间减少，其中82%的人报告编写代码的时间有所减少。我们发现工作重心发生了更广泛的转变，从创造活动转向验证活动。我们提出了一类新的工作，称之为“监督性工程工作”，涵盖对AI输出的指导、评估和纠正。这一概念比文献中此前报道的额外审查开销更为广泛，因为它还包括在AI输出生成之前和期间对其进行的引导和塑造。
tldr: 该纵向研究发现，AI编程助手使开发者将工作重心从代码创造转向验证活动，并首次提出“监督性工程工作”这一新概念，即对AI输出进行指导、评估和纠正的新型工作模式。
en_tdlr: This longitudinal study reveals that AI coding assistants shift developers' focus from code creation to verification activities, and introduces the novel concept of "supervisory engineering work" encompassing the direction, evaluation, and correction of AI output.
